verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents managed LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators that automatically score live production traces through evaluator rules, run on a sample of live traffic. This is documented alongside, and separately from, offline dataset experiments, so continuous production evaluation is clearly a first-party capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of continuous production evaluation, and deeper documentation of rule filtering and sampling configuration; one community report also questioned whether this is available on self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Automatically score live production traces LLM-as-a-Judge, Scores via API/SDK
To score live production traces with an evaluator and a rule, start with Evaluate Production Traffic.
